video_title: LeBron James to PHILLY?! Dwyane Wade & Candace Parker React to 76ers Move | Post Moves

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' decision to join the 76ers is on brand
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is never going to do what you think he's going to do.
quotes.quote: LeBron is never going to do what you think he's going to do. I don't think any of us had Philly pinned as the number one team, but it's right on brand. For me, when I look at that, it's a bigger than just a championship. The roster is incredible right now, and so he gets a chance to get to that maybe five, six championships. Outside of that, I look at that as an off-the-basketball move as well. I feel like it's bigger than just the two years.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade reflects on the initial Miami Heat recruitment handshake
quotes.excerpt: We obviously talked about it. We had a handshake like, okay, we're going to do this.
quotes.quote: We obviously talked about it. We had a handshake like, okay, we're going to do this. But then a couple weeks passed and I didn't hear from him. So I didn't know. I'm like, well maybe he changed his mind. He didn't answer my text messages. So yeah, but I was watching it like everybody else because I'm like, maybe. I know it was a tough decision by the way, too. I was watching it. I did a watch party and everybody thought I was like, oh, he knew. No, we had an agreement, but also too, things change.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the importance of having great teammates
quotes.excerpt: It's all about having great teammates in all aspects of your life.
quotes.quote: It's all about having great teammates in all aspects of your life. When you got a cast like Kevin Harlan, Candace Parker, myself, and Alley Clifton as well, we have a good time. We love the game, we all know the game the way that we know it and we see it, and we all, you and I, we don't always agree. And that's the way it should be because we see the game differently, but we have a good time.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the growth and impact of women's basketball
quotes.excerpt: I feel honored and blessed to be here where while it's happening.
quotes.quote: I feel honored and blessed to be here where while it's happening. I think we all are watching the explosion of women's sports and the women's game. I just want to be a part of that in the sense of community aspects, in the sense of this is Chicago, I am born and raised here, but also too, just giving back to the game of basketball all around.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade recounts a late-night Portillo's run in Chicago
quotes.excerpt: We were hungry and both of our favorite places to go was Portillo's.
quotes.quote: Last time we were in Chicago, Candace and I had a chance to be here for the President Obama Center opening. We were hanging out afterwards, after the after-party, and we were hungry. Both of our favorite places to go was Portillo's, so we were like, Portillo's. We hop in the car, we go to Portillo's. It's probably 11:30, 12:00, and we get up there and they're like, what you want? We like, let me get a Polish. And they were like, no, Polish is stop at 11:00. You should have heard the scream in the car.
